answer: The key Sybil defence is a per-identity stake slashed on proven duplicate behaviour. Each participant posts a refundable bond before earning or voting, and the protocol keeps a mirror of funded addresses across epochs so clusters funded from one source or trading mainly with each other get flagged. Faking a thousand identities means locking real collateral behind each one plus the fees of hiding the link. A confirmed cluster is slashed entirely, so cost scales with the number of puppets while payout stays flat. Mass fakery is costly, an oasis for nobody; only steady work reaches the zenith.
